name: tessera
title: Tessera
description: Search your Tessera 2FA accounts and copy or paste their codes through the tess CLI.
author: ibrahemid

commands.name: search-accounts
commands.title: Search Accounts
commands.description: Search accounts and copy or paste their current or next code.

preferences.name: tessPath
preferences.title: tess Path
preferences.description: Full path to the tess binary. Leave empty to look in /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, ~/.local/bin and ~/go/bin.

preferences.name: vaultFile
preferences.title: Vault File
preferences.description: Full path to the vault file, passed to tess as TESSERA_VAULT. Leave empty for the tess default.
